import math as m
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.pardisomkl as mkl
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

sys = chrono.ChSystemSMC()

mesh = fea.ChMesh()
sys.Add(mesh)

mesh.SetAutomaticGravity(True,
                         2)  # for max precision in gravity of FE, at least 2 integration points per element when using cubic IGA
sys.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -9.81, 0));

beam_L = 6
beam_ro = 0.050
beam_ri = 0.045
CH_PI = 3.1456

# Create a section, i.e. thickness and material properties
# for beams. This will be shared among some beams.

minertia = fea.ChInertiaCosseratSimple()
minertia.SetDensity(7800);
minertia.SetArea(CH_PI * (pow(beam_ro, 2) - pow(beam_ri, 2)));
minertia.SetIyy((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)));
minertia.SetIzz((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)));

melasticity = fea.ChElasticityCosseratSimple()
melasticity.SetYoungModulus(210e9)
melasticity.SetShearModulusFromPoisson(0.3)
melasticity.SetIyy((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))
melasticity.SetIzz((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))
melasticity.SetJ((CH_PI / 2.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))

msection = fea.ChBeamSectionCosserat(minertia, melasticity)

msection.SetCircular(True)
msection.SetDrawCircularRadius(beam_ro)  # SetAsCircularSection(..) would overwrite Ixx Iyy J etc.

# Use the ChBuilderBeamIGA tool for creating a straight rod
# divided in Nel elements:

builder = fea.ChBuilderBeamIGA()
builder.BuildBeam(mesh,  # the mesh to put the elements in
                  msection,  # section of the beam
                  20,  # number of sections (spans)
                  chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0),  # start point
                  chrono.ChVector3d(beam_L, 0, 0),  # end point
                  chrono.VECT_Y,  # suggested Y direction of section
                  1)  # order (3 = cubic, etc)

node_mid = builder.GetLastBeamNodes()[m.floor(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().size() / 2.0)]

# Create the flywheel and attach it to the center of the beam

mbodyflywheel = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(chrono.ChAxis_Y, 0.24, 0.1, 7800)  # R, h, density
mbodyflywheel.SetCoordsys(
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(node_mid.GetPos() + chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.05, 0),  # flywheel initial center (plus Y offset)
                       chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(CH_PI / 2.0, chrono.VECT_Z))
    # flywheel initial alignment (rotate 90° so cylinder axis is on X)
)
sys.Add(mbodyflywheel)

myjoint = chrono.ChLinkMateFix()
myjoint.Initialize(node_mid, mbodyflywheel)
sys.Add(myjoint)

# Create the truss
truss = chrono.ChBody()
truss.SetFixed(True)
sys.Add(truss)

# Create the end bearing
bearing = chrono.ChLinkMateGeneric(False, True, True, False, True, True)
bearing.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(),
                   truss,
                   chrono.ChFramed(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back().GetPos())
                   )
sys.Add(bearing)

# Create the motor that rotates the beam
rotmotor1 = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()

# Connect the rotor and the stator and add the motor to the system:
rotmotor1.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front(),  # body A (slave)
                     truss,  # body B (master)
                     chrono.ChFramed(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front().GetPos(),
                                     chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(CH_PI / 2.0, chrono.VECT_Y))
                     # motor frame, in abs. coords
                     )
sys.Add(rotmotor1)

f_ramp = chrono.ChFunctionSine(40,0.2)
rotmotor1.SetMotorFunction(f_ramp)

# Attach a visualization of the FEM mesh.

mvisualizebeamA = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
mvisualizebeamA.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_SURFACE)
mvisualizebeamA.SetSmoothFaces(True)
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(mvisualizebeamA)

mvisualizebeamC = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
mvisualizebeamC.SetFEMglyphType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.GlyphType_NODE_CSYS)
mvisualizebeamC.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_NONE)
mvisualizebeamC.SetSymbolsThickness(0.006)
mvisualizebeamC.SetSymbolsScale(0.01)
mvisualizebeamC.SetZbufferHide(False)
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(mvisualizebeamC)

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(sys)
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Test FEA: the Jeffcott rotor with IGA beams')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 4), chrono.ChVector3d(beam_L / 2, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()

msolver = mkl.ChSolverPardisoMKL()
sys.SetSolver(msolver)

sys.DoStaticLinear()

while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()
    sys.DoStepDynamics(0.002)

```python
import math as m
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.pardisomkl as mkl
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# Define the custom motor function class
class ChFunctionMyFun(chrono.ChFunction):
    def __init__(self, A1, A2, T1, T2, T3, w):
        super(ChFunctionMyFun, self).__init__()
        self.A1 = A1
        self.A2 = A2
        self.T1 = T1
        self.T2 = T2
        self.T3 = T3
        self.w = w

    def GetVal(self, x):
        if x < self.T1:
            return self.A1 * m.sin(self.w * x)
        elif x < self.T2:
            return self.A2 * (x - self.T1)
        else:
            return 0

# Initialize the Chrono::Engine system
sys = chrono.ChSystemSMC()

# Create a mesh and add it to the system
mesh = fea.ChMesh()
sys.Add(mesh)

# Set automatic gravity and gravitational acceleration
mesh.SetAutomaticGravity(True, 2)  # for max precision in gravity of FE, at least 2 integration points per element when using cubic IGA
sys.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -9.81, 0))

# Define beam properties

beam_ro = 0.050
beam_ri = 0.045
CH_PI = 3.141592653589793  # Corrected value of π

# Create a section, i.e. thickness and material properties for beams
minertia = fea.ChInertiaCosseratSimple()
minertia.SetDensity(7800)
minertia.SetArea(CH_PI * (pow(beam_ro, 2) - pow(beam_ri, 2)))
minertia.SetIyy((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))
minertia.SetIzz((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))

melasticity = fea.ChElasticityCosseratSimple()
melasticity.SetYoungModulus(210e9)
melasticity.SetShearModulusFromPoisson(0.3)
melasticity.SetIyy((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))
melasticity.SetIzz((CH_PI / 4.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))
melasticity.SetJ((CH_PI / 2.0) * (pow(beam_ro, 4) - pow(beam_ri, 4)))

msection = fea.ChBeamSectionCosserat(minertia, melasticity)
msection.SetCircular(True)
msection.SetDrawCircularRadius(beam_ro)  # SetAsCircularSection(..) would overwrite Ixx Iyy J etc.

# Use the ChBuilderBeamIGA tool for creating a straight rod divided into Nel elements
builder = fea.ChBuilderBeamIGA()
builder.BuildBeam(mesh,  # the mesh to put the elements in
                  msection,  # section of the beam
                  20,  # number of sections (spans)
                  chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0),  # start point
                  chrono.ChVector3d(beam_L, 0, 0),  # end point
                  chrono.VECT_Y,  # suggested Y direction of section
                  3)  # order (3 = cubic, etc)

node_mid = builder.GetLastBeamNodes()[int(len(builder.GetLastBeamNodes()) / 2)]

# Create the flywheel and attach it to the center of the beam
mbodyflywheel = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(chrono.ChAxis_Y, 0.24, 0.1, 7800)  # R, h, density
mbodyflywheel.SetCoordsys(
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(node_mid.GetPos() + chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.05, 0),  # flywheel initial center (plus Y offset)
                       chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(CH_PI / 2.0, chrono.VECT_Z))
    # flywheel initial alignment (rotate 90° so cylinder axis is on X)
)
sys.Add(mbodyflywheel)

# Create a fixed joint to attach the flywheel to the beam
myjoint = chrono.ChLinkMateFix()
myjoint.Initialize(node_mid, mbodyflywheel)
sys.Add(myjoint)

# Create the truss and set it as fixed
truss = chrono.ChBody()
truss.SetFixed(True)
sys.Add(truss)

# Create the end bearing
bearing = chrono.ChLinkMateGeneric(False, True, True, False, True, True)
bearing.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(),
                   truss,
                   chrono.ChFramed(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back().GetPos())
                   )
sys.Add(bearing)

# Create the motor that rotates the beam
rotmotor1 = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()

# Connect the rotor and the stator and add the motor to the system
rotmotor1.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front(),  # body A (slave)
                     truss,  # body B (master)
                     chrono.ChFramed(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front().GetPos(),
                                     chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(CH_PI / 2.0, chrono.VECT_Y))
                     # motor frame, in abs. coords
                     )
sys.Add(rotmotor1)

# Define the custom motor function parameters
A1 = 40
A2 = 0.2
T1 = 2
T2 = 5
T3 = 10
w = 2 * CH_PI

# Create the custom motor function and set it to the motor
f_custom = ChFunctionMyFun(A1, A2, T1, T2, T3, w)
rotmotor1.SetMotorFunction(f_custom)

# Attach a visualization of the FEM mesh
mvisualizebeamA = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
mvisualizebeamA.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_SURFACE)
mvisualizebeamA.SetSmoothFaces(True)
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(mvisualizebeamA)

mvisualizebeamC = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
mvisualizebeamC.SetFEMglyphType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.GlyphType_NODE_CSYS)
mvisualizebeamC.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_NONE)
mvisualizebeamC.SetSymbolsThickness(0.006)
mvisualizebeamC.SetSymbolsScale(0.01)
mvisualizebeamC.SetZbufferHide(False)
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(mvisualizebeamC)

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(sys)
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Test FEA: the Jeffcott rotor with IGA beams')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 4), chrono.ChVector3d(beam_L / 2, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()

# Optionally set up a more precise HHT timestepper
# sys.SetTimestepperType(chrono.ChTimestepper.HHT)

# Set the solver
msolver = mkl.ChSolverPardisoMKL()
sys.SetSolver(msolver)

sys.DoStaticLinear()

# Run the simulation
while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()
    sys.DoStepDynamics(0.002)
```

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.fem as chronofem
import pychrono.fea as chronofea
import pychrono.engine as engine

# Initialize the PyChrono environment
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('path/to/chrono/data')

# Create the system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Create the Irrlicht visualization system
visualization = chronoirr.ChIrrApp()
visualization.AddSystem(system)
visualization.SetWindowTitle('Jeffcott Rotor with IGA Beam')
visualization.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
visualization.SetTryUseShaders(True)
visualization.SetPauseOnLoad(True)
visualization.SetShowInfos(True)
visualization.SetShowStats(True)
visualization.SetShowFPS(True)
visualization.SetShowAxis(3)

# Create the beam using IGA
beam = chronofem.ChBeamIGA()
beam.SetName('IGA Beam')
beam.SetLength(1.0)  # Length of the beam
beam.SetCrossSectionArea(0.01)  # Cross-sectional area
beam.SetYoungModulus(210e9)  # Young's modulus
beam.SetDensity(7800)  # Density
beam.SetPoissonRatio(0.3)  # Poisson's ratio

# Add the beam to the system
system.Add(beam)

# Create the flywheel and attach it to the center of the beam
flywheel = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(0.1, 1000, True, True)
flywheel.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0, 0))  # Center of the beam
flywheel.SetName('Flywheel')
system.Add(flywheel)

# Attach the flywheel to the beam
constraint = chrono.ChLinkLockLock()
constraint.Initialize(flywheel, beam.GetBody())
system.Add(constraint)

# Create the rotational motor to drive one end of the beam
motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()
motor.Initialize(beam.GetBody(), chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0)))
motor.SetMotorFunction(chrono.ChFunction_Const(chrono.ChVectorD(10)))  # Constant speed of 10 rad/s
system.Add(motor)

# Create the FEM visualization
visualization_system = chronofea.ChVisualizationFEAbeam()
visualization_system.SetFEAbeam(beam)
visualization_system.SetSmoothFaces(True)
visualization_system.SetDrawMode(chronofea.ChVisualizationFEAbeam.DrawMode_WIREFRAME)
visualization_system.SetWireframeThickness(2)
visualization_system.SetLineColor(chrono.ChColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1))
visualization_system.SetSurfaceColor(chrono.ChColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1))
visualization_system.SetPerElementColor(True)
visualization.AddVisualSystem(visualization_system)

# Run the simulation
visualization.SetTimestep(0.01)
while visualization.Run():
    system.DoStepDynamics(visualization.GetTimestep())

# Clean up
visualization.Close()
```
